jobs.title: Part-Time Focus Group Panelists. Call Centre Agent Welcome. No Experience
jobs.description:
Job Description

ApexFocusGroup collaborates with research firms, universities, and trusted brands to gather genuine consumer insights. We help connect everyday people with flexible remote market research opportunities that influence real products, services, and customer experiences. Role Overview :We are welcoming participants from all backgrounds, including anyone looking for call centre agent roles, to take part in upcoming focus group research studies. These may involve online discussions, product testing, or feedback sessions - typically conducted remotely online.This is a casual, project-based opportunity ideal for anyone interested in taking part in research on a part time basis, depending on their availability and profile fit. Requirements :Access to a smartphone, tablet, or computer with a functional cameraReliable internet connectionAbility to read instructions carefully and provide honest, detailed feedbackAn active email address to receive study invitations and participation detailsBenefits:Take part only in studies that match your interests and scheduleResearch types include online or in-person focus groups, virtual interviews, product testing, and other feedback activitiesNo experience needed, including no previous call centre agent background. Just a willingness to share your opinionsSome studies may include early access to new products or services before launchMany studies offer compensation, which varies by study type and durationCompensation:Up to £700 per week (amount varies based on the selected focus group or research assignment)If you'd like to contribute to research that influences real-world products and decisions, or simply looking for flexible part-time remote roles, we invite you to submit your interest online today.Important Notice – No Fees Required: Participation is always free. We never request or accept any fees for registration or study involvement. Please stay cautious and only respond to communications sent directly from us.

jobs.title: Casual Funeral Service Operative
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position: Casual Funeral Service OperativeLocation: J Rymer Funeral Directors, Monkgate - YorkJob Type: CasualSalary: £13.40 per hourWe're looking for compassionate individuals to join our team on a casual basis, supporting families during funeral services and behind the scenes. This flexible opportunity is ideal for those who want to make a difference in their community while working around other commitments.The RoleYou'll be part of a team that ensures every service is delivered with dignity and respect. This position is well-suited to individuals who are looking to work occasionally and contribute in a meaningful way, especially during peak periods or when extra ceremonial support is required. Key Responsibilities : Assisting at funeral services, bearing coffins, setting up venues, and supporting mourners.Driving and operating specialist vehicles such as hearses and limousines.Representing Dignity Funerals with professionalism and empathy.Providing respectful, discreet support to families on the day of the service.Maintaining ceremonial standards in appearance, conduct, and service delivery.About YouWe're looking for someone who: Holds a Full UK Driving Licence (Essential).Demonstrates compassion, empathy, and professionalism.Understands the importance of presentation and discretion.Is physically capable of manual handling tasks, including lifting and carrying.Is reliable, punctual, and flexible with working hours, including short-notice availability.Is comfortable with tasks that involve direct contact with the deceased.No previous experience in funeral care is required; full training and uniform will be provided.What you can expect from usWe know the difference our casual colleagues make every day. That's why we're committed to providing a supportive environment, flexible working opportunities and a range of benefits that help you feel valued as part of the Dignity team. Time to recharge - Accrue up to 22 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, based on the hours you work, giving you valuable time to rest, recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.Planning for your future - 4% matched pension to help you build long-term financial security.Everyday savings and perks - Access to MyStaffShop, our employee rewards platform, offering savings across high street and online retailers, alongside eyecare support, flu jab reimbursement and lifestyle discounts.Support when you need it - Access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme, occupational health services and confidential counselling.Learn and grow with us - Ongoing training and development, including internal learning pathways and apprenticeship opportunities.Making work easier - Free on-site parking available at most of our locations.If you're looking to be part of a compassionate team and want to support people when they need it most, we'd love to hear from you.What are the next steps?To join us in this role, simply hit the 'apply' button to submit your application and a member of our Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch!Why DignityDignity exists to help every family in Britain navigate the hardest moments of life with simplicity, dignity, kindness and exceptional care. That's true whether you're with us full-time, part-time, or on a casual basis, across our Dignity Funerals branches or our CMG crematorium and cemetery sites.Casual roles with us are built around flexibility. You choose the shifts that work for you, with no minimum hours and no long-term commitment, so the work fits around your life, whether that's family, study, another job, or just wanting to work when it suits you.The work itself still matters. Every shift you pick up is helping a family through one of the hardest moments of their lives, and you'll be properly trained and supported to do it well, just like the rest of the team.If you're looking for flexible, genuinely worthwhile work that you can pick up and put down as life demands, this is a good place to do it.FCA StatementDignity is part of a group that includes FCA-regulated activities, and some roles may be subject to relevant training, screening, conduct, and regulatory requirements . This will be confirmed as part of the recruitment process.Equality, Diversity and Inclusion StatementWe know that diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create a better place to work. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever your life looks like, we'd love to hear from you. And if there's anything you need to make the process more accessible, please let us knowAny unsolicited submissions from agencies will be accepted as a direct application from the candidate and no fees will be payable.We reserve the right depending on application numbers to close or extend the closing dates for positions; we would therefore recommend an early application.TPBN1_UKTJ
